Audemars Piguet · ref. 26240ST

Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph

Sports chronograph · 38–41mm · 50m · automatic

The Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph is a luxury sports watch that adds a chronograph complication to the iconic Royal Oak design. It is defined by its octagonal bezel with exposed screws, integrated bracelet, and "Tapisserie" patterned dial.

The story

The first Royal Oak Chronograph, reference 25860, was introduced in 1997 to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the Royal Oak. Initially launched with a 39mm case, the model family evolved in case size, with a significant update to 41mm in 2012 with the reference 26320. For its first 25 years, the collection was powered by the Calibre 2385, which was based on a Frédéric Piguet movement. A major turning point came in 2022 with the introduction of the in-house Calibre 4401 in the 41mm models, bringing with it a flyback function and a sapphire caseback. The family has also expanded to include 38mm versions and a variety of materials beyond stainless steel.
